User is preparing a supply order for the Jorton depot.
- Add 120 lanterns, 180 ladders, 220 tarps, and 240 cable reels.
- Task: Send meeting notes to Vik, Leon, Suri, Dell, Bram, Rafe, Esme. Send morning notes to Rafe and Greta. Send evening notes to Jonah and Kira. Send evening meeting notes to Cora.
- People Out: Jonah (Cora), Wren (Una), Hugo (Rafe), Teo (Finn), Esme (Nils). Una, Finn, Nils, Greta out; covered by Mira, Ada, Vik, Una.
- Desk Swaps: Mira/Dell, Vik/Kira, Ines/Mira, Rafe/Opal, Kira/Rafe, Mira/Bram, and Jonah/Dell swapping this week.
- Stand-ups: Morning (harbour room), afternoon (east wing), evening (loading bay).
- Room Availability: Nils (harbour afternoon), Hugo (east wing afternoon), Greta (print room afternoon). Suri asked if east wing is free afternoon. Nils asked if print room is free morning. Teo asked if east wing is free morning. Pia wants east wing kept clear for visitors. Leon prefers garden studio for reviews. Mira thinks library annex is too cold afternoon.
- Cold Rooms: Jonah (garden studio evening), Mira (harbour room morning), Vik (loading bay afternoon), Cora (garden studio afternoon).
- Updates: Rafe/Leon want garden studio/print room clear for visitors. Umbrellas in loading bay, east wing, library annex, print room, harbour room, and garden studio. Print room/east wing/library annex repainting (noise). Working coffee machines: harbour, print room, loading bay, east wing, library annex. Maintenance: Lifts near east wing, loading bay, library annex, north office slow. North office repainting (noise). Rafe out rest of week; Dell covering. Rafe thinks harbour room is too cold in morning.
